**Resubmitted — GOVLAW: deviation, preferred level, redline validated (ok:true).**

Repairs made in response to the verifier:

1. **Contradictory arbitral-award language removed in operative text** (no longer deferred to a "conforming pass"): the JAMS Expedited Procedures modifications and "The proceedings and decisions of the arbitrator shall be final and binding... judgment on the award may be entered in any court having jurisdiction" are struck from p0630 (retaining only the English-language requirement), and Sections 15.6(b)–(e) (arbitration confidentiality, arbitrator selection, award timing, arbitrator fee awards) are replaced with "[Intentionally omitted.]" so lettering and cross-references stay intact.

2. **15.6(j) conformed**: narrowed from general "equitable relief or interim or provisional relief" to "a temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction or other interim equitable relief," and the dangling "either prior to or during any arbitration" anchor replaced with "pending resolution of a Dispute in the courts designated in Section 15.6(a)" — matching the element's "subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere."

3. **Unrelated commercial language restored/preserved rather than deleted**: the mutual punitive/exemplary damages waiver (15.6(f)) and the compliance/termination-stay mechanic (15.6(g)) survive, conformed to "Dispute"; 15.6(i)'s cross-reference to the omitted 15.6(c) is repointed to 15.6(a); 15.6(h) subject-matter carve-out untouched.

4. **Element 1** (New York law) remains already met by unmodified Section 15.5 — no governing-law edit made.
